questions.question_text: Many problems naturally contain higher-order -body interactions (HUBO) rather than just quadratic ones (QUBO). What is a primary advantage of tackling HUBO problems natively on a digital gate-based processor compared to a standard 2-local quantum annealer?

In Adiabatic Quantum Optimization (AQO), evolving too rapidly across a small minimum spectral gap induces nonadiabatic transitions out of the ground state. How does Counterdiabatic (CD) driving address this limitation?

Suppose your adiabatic Hamiltonian combines a standard transverse-field mixer with an Ising problem Hamiltonian containing both longitudinal fields and pairwise interactions . When approximating the adiabatic gauge potential through the first-order expression , which Pauli operators appear?

Variational quantum algorithms such as QAOA can face trainability challenges, including barren plateaus in certain regimes, and substantial measurement overhead from classical parameter optimization. How does Bias-Field DCQO (BF-DCQO) iteratively steer the dynamics toward the ground state without variational parameter training?
For an Ising problem Hamiltonian containing only Pauli-Z products, how can the energy of a measured computational-basis state be calculated?
Increasing the order of the nested-commutator expansion can improve the approximation of the adiabatic gauge potential. Why might a lower-order approximation still be preferable on noisy hardware?
Why does quantum error correction measure error syndromes instead of directly measuring the physical qubits storing an encoded quantum state?
Consider the three-qubit repetition code with logical states and . Which pair of stabilizers can be measured to detect and identify single-qubit bit-flip errors?
A physical qubit in a bit-flip repetition code undergoes an unwanted rotation around the axis. How can quantum error correction correct this error, even if the rotation angle is unknown?
In a CSS quantum error-correcting code, an -type stabilizer and a -type stabilizer must commute. What condition ensures that they commute?
Which technique is used to combine the bit-flip and phase-flip repetition codes into the nine-qubit Shor code?
Under which condition can increasing the code distance systematically suppress the logical error rate as the code becomes larger?
How can we protect quantum error correction against syndrome measurement errors as the code distance increases?
